integrity: Results and proofs are self-contained; relevant motivating and related literature is attributed; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The log-cosh boundary integral is evaluated directly on facets of nonsmooth parallelotopes; smooth-covariogram convergence is not asserted for them. Historical priority is provisional; one foundational Orlicz article was inaccessible in full. Floating-point verification is supplementary, not proof.
title: Exact John–Löwner ellipsoids and distortion of a critical log-cosh projection body for parallelotopes
